pending.description: What the physics manager has queued for this entity, a mix of PhysicsFeature::PhysicsPending. Anything but a zero means the entity is in the managers rebuild queue.

body.description: Entity whose physx actor owns the shapes of this entity, which is the entity itself for a body. Cached so a collider which was moved to another parent can detach its shape from the old actor without walking the hierarchy.

displacement.description: The displacement for the next physics frame.

isGrounded.description: Informs if the character is touching the floor or not.

actorType.description: The physx actor type of the body.

mass.description: Mass in kilograms. 0 means the mass is derived from the shape volumes and the material densities.

useGravity.description: If the body is affected by gravity.

ccd.description: Continuous collision detection for the body.

collisionGroup.description: Simulation filter data word0, read by the simulation filter shader.

collisionFeedback.description: Simulation filter data word1, controls which contact callbacks are sent.
